تبتسرين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَسِرِينَ (tabtasirīna) /tab.ta.si.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# تُبْتَسَرِينَ (tubtasarīna) /tub.ta.sa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
